MAIN-STREET HIGH-NOON STANDOFF — camera flat at minifig-boot level down the tan-plate street centerline, two gunfighters at opposite ends, false-front brick facades receding into the dusty gap between them.

SALOON-INTERIOR OVER-THE-BAR — camera behind the printed brick bar-top past bottle-shelf tiles looking into the dim room, a brawl mid-swing, batwing-doors flung wide letting harsh noon light flood in.

STAGECOACH-CHASE TRACKING — camera locked alongside the brick stagecoach at wheel-height, horses stretched mid-gallop, Technic-axle dust-plates kicking, red-rock butte plates blurring static in the background.

CANYON-RIM AMBUSH-DOWN — camera perched on stacked-plate canyon-rim sandstone looking nearly straight down at a lone rider on the trail below, ambush-figures crouching in silhouette at the foreground rim edge.

TRAIN-TOP RUNNING — camera low on the brick boxcar roof looking forward along the running minifig toward locomotive smoke, desert mesa plates streaming both flanks, the heist-wind angle hammering through.

MESA-SILHOUETTE WIDE — camera wide and ground-flat on tan-plate desert floor, enormous stacked-plate mesas looming against a solid-blue brick sky, a single wagon crossing the middle-ground for frontier scale.
SHERIFF-PORCH LOW — camera at boardwalk-plank level angled up at the sheriff standing under the jail-porch awning, WANTED-board tiles beside the door, the brick main-street shrinking away behind.
MINE-SHAFT DOWN — camera at the timbered shaft-mouth angling steeply down the ore-cart rail descent, lantern-brick glow warming the dark walls, two miner-figs hunched over a loaded cart below.

BOARDWALK RECEDING — camera at plank-level looking down the full boardwalk length past barrel-stacks and hitching-post horses, storefront porch pillars shrinking toward a vanishing-point false-front at the far end.

CAMPFIRE OVER-SHOULDER — camera just behind a cowboy minifig looking past their hat-brim at trans-orange campfire bricks, two trail-hands opposite, a picketed horse blurred in the far dark behind them.
SALOON-STAIRCASE AMBUSH — camera at mid-stair level on the interior balcony looking down at the saloon floor, a crouched minifig gripping the brick railing above an unsuspecting card-game below.

WATER-TOWER SNIPER PERCH — camera tight behind a minifig wedged against the brick water-tower legs high above main street, rifle trained downward, the tiny standoff figures and dusty storefronts spread far below.
